name: @dsh-external/dsh-tool-scope
description: Per-mode tool visibility scope: hides global tool declarations that the current session mode can never call. Each plugin already declares its own mode gate (webshell-mgr ALLOWED_MODES=[pentest], ctf-observer MODE_ID=ctf-solver, redteam-results/campaign-memory/trace-vault/knowledge-hub MODE_IDS=[pentest,code-audit,ctf-solver]) — outside those modes the call is hard-rejected, yet the schemas still ride every request. Measured: tool definitions are 67.8% of a 164KB request (101 tools, 111.5K bytes). This plugin applies the host's native per-agent tools.restrict() at session creation so those declarations never enter the prompt. Deny-only, self-limiting, fail-visible, and switchable off per rule.
author: Saker contributors
